label: Applied AI role
text:
Applied AI Engineer — Northstar Research (synthetic)
We are hiring an engineer to build practical AI tools for research teams.
Candidates must have Python and API development experience.
Experience evaluating model quality is required.
TypeScript experience is preferred.
The role is remote within India.
Success will be evaluated through reliability and documented evaluation results.
The engineer reports to the research platform lead.

label: Consulting RFP
text:
Knowledge workflow pilot — Cedar Advisory (synthetic)
We seek a consultant for a small consulting engagement to improve internal knowledge discovery.
The consultant must review existing document workflows.
Deliver a working search prototype and a handover report.
The prototype must use a supplied sample of confidential customer data.
The budget is INR 400,000 and delivery is required within six weeks.
Success means finding the correct source for 18 of 20 agreed test questions.
Contact the operations sponsor to clarify access arrangements.

label: AI hackathon
text:
Useful AI Weekend — synthetic hackathon brief
Build a practical AI prototype that helps a community organization.
Teams must use public or synthetic data only.
Submit source code, a three-minute demo and setup documentation.
The deadline is 48 hours after the event starts.
Judging considers usefulness, technical quality and clarity of the demo.
The prize is a mentoring session; no cash prize is offered.
All work must be created during the event.
